name: Zdounky (Czechia)
description: A green vertical stripe at the hoist one third of the flag's length, and two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red in the fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 29 March 1995 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
